spans.s:
म्यक्ष् म्यक्ष् (a Vedic verb, of which the
following forms are found, म्यक्षति, मिम्यक्ष,
मिमिक्षतुस्, मिमिक्षुस्, मिमिक्षिरे, अम्यक्,
मिमिक्षत्), to be fixed in or on; to be in any
place or state; to be near, to be present, to be at
hand; to go to, reach; to be associated or united;
(Sāy. = प्राप्नोति, सङ्गच्छते, संहतो भ-
वति.)
